orders: Observe gait pattern (walking assessment) - careful observation of the patient's walking pattern, looking specifically for circumduction, foot drop, Trendelenburg gait, or antalgic gait.
Single leg stance test on the right leg
Manual muscle testing of right lower extremity (hip flexion, knee extension, ankle dorsiflexion, ankle plantarflexion, great toe extension)
Finger-to-nose test and rapid alternating movements (dysdiadochokinesia testing) on the left upper extremity
Hypometric/overshoot testing - observe for past pointing
Nystagmus testing (saccadic eye movements, smooth pursuit, convergence)
Comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) including liver function tests and albumin
Serum prealbumin (transthyretin) level for acute malnutrition assessment
Serum ketone bodies (beta-hydroxybutyrate) - to evaluate for metabolic acidosis from starvation
